items.context: Kya aapko sim activate karwana hai?
items.text: nahi abhi nahi
mera old sim ka number 98765 43210 hai
main apna sim port karwana chahta hoon from Airtel
sim replace karne ke liye kya documents chahiye hote hain
mera sim phone me sahi se kaam nahi kar raha hai
kya port ke liye koi charges dene padte hain
number port karne me kitna time lagta hai normally
mera current operator Vodafone hai main port karna chahta hoon

items.context: Please provide your current sim number for porting
items.text: mera sim number 99887 66554 hai port request karna hai

items.context: Kya aapko documents submit karne hain?
items.text: kya main apna address proof dena hoga sim replacement ke liye

items.context: Kab se aapke sim me network issue aa raha hai?
items.text: meri sim activate hone me ek hafte ho gaye par network nahi mil raha

items.context: Kya aapke phone ka sim slot problem hai?
items.text: mobile phone me sim slot kharab hai isliye sim replace karwana hai

items.context: Aapko port karne ke baad old sim kaise chalge?
items.text: kya port karne par old number pe calls aur messages aate rahenge
mera purana sim vodafone ka hai aur main ise jio me port karwana chahta hoon aur mera number 91234 56789 hai
main apna sim replace karwana chahta hoon kyuki mera sim damage ho gaya hai aur new sim delivery kab hogi bataiye
port karne ke liye mujhe kya karna hoga aur kitna samay lagta hai poora process complete hone me

items.context: Sim port karwana chahenge toh kya process hai aapke hisaab se?
items.text: mera sim nahi chal raha hai lekin main port karna chahta hoon kya aap madad kar sakte hain uske liye

items.context: Kya aapke paas required documents hain port karne ke liye?
items.text: old sim Airtel se main switch karna chahta hoon jio me mera number 99800 11223 hai aur documents ready hain

items.context: Sim replace karane ke liye urgency batayein please
items.text: mera sim pura ka pura network issue me hai isliye main turant ek naye sim se replace karwana chahta hoon prompt delivery hona chahiye

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: port_or_sim - wants to port the number, replace or swap a SIM
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
